column1: 先准备好护照，再问学校需要什么。|Prepare your passport, then ask the school what you need.|学校很方便，有问题可以问老师。|The school is convenient; you can ask a teacher if you have questions.|要是你来中国，我们就可以一起学习。|If you come to China, we can study together.

我想租一个离学校近的房间。|I want to rent a room near school.|这个房间很好，不过我还想看看周围。|This room is good, but I would like to look around the neighbourhood.|每个月多少钱？什么时候可以搬进来？|How much is it per month? When can I move in?

我觉得网上买东西很方便，不用出门。|I think shopping online is convenient; there is no need to go out.|去商店可以买到合适的东西，也能问服务员。|In a shop you can find suitable things and ask an assistant.|我觉得两种方式都可以，要看买什么。|I think either way works; it depends on what you are buying.

我住在学校，去教室很近。|I live at school, close to the classroom.|我每天走路上学，既方便又能锻炼身体。|I walk to school each day; it is convenient and gives me exercise.|我住得远，一般坐地铁去学校。|I live far away and usually take the subway to school.
我喜欢吃鱼，也喜欢吃米饭。|I like fish and rice.|我们一般和家人一起吃饭，边吃边聊。|We usually eat with family and chat during the meal.|请客时，我会先问大家喜欢吃什么。|When treating people to a meal, I first ask what they like to eat.

我不舒服时会先去医院，看医生怎么说。|When I feel unwell, I go to the hospital and listen to the doctor.|我会请朋友陪我去，帮我听懂医生的话。|I would ask a friend to go with me and help me understand the doctor.|每个地方看病的方式不一样，不懂就问。|The process differs from place to place; ask if you do not understand.

我觉得工作时要多学习，也要好好休息。|I think we should learn at work and also rest properly.|如果一直换工作，就很难了解一个公司。|If we keep changing jobs, it is hard to understand a company.|我觉得要先想清楚自己喜欢什么工作。|I think we should first understand what work we like.

我喜欢周末出去走走，看看山和水。|I like going for a walk on weekends and seeing mountains and water.|我也喜欢在家看书，这样很安静。|I also like reading at home because it is peaceful.|不管去哪里，能好好休息就行。|Wherever we go, it is enough to rest properly.

我觉得朋友之间要多听对方说话。|I think friends should listen to each other more.|两个人可以有不同的爱好，也可以相互帮助。|Two people can have different hobbies and still help each other.|对我来说，有问题时愿意一起解决很重要。|For me, being willing to solve problems together is important.

我想冬天去北方看雪，要先准备好衣服。|I want to see snow in the north in winter, so I need to prepare clothes.|我喜欢去暖和的地方，可以在外面多走走。|I like visiting warm places where I can walk outside more.|去哪儿以前，我会先看看天气，再安排时间。|Before travelling, I check the weather and then arrange the schedule.
